statement: Challenge: carry a full party of 10 in World 3 party dungeon with only one active player while nine do nothing.
Divine Knight is the best character for party dungeons by a decent margin early or late game; the go-to class.
Rank trait setup focuses on early damage: rank 5 plus 3 base damage; rank 10 two gray RNG items; rank 15 green RNG item; rank 35 25% rarity; rank 40 purple RNG item.
Rank 50 trait gives 150% attack speed and one purple RNG item at the cost of max MP being 1.
Drops don't matter in World 3 party dungeons so avoid drop rate and focus only on damage.
Focus cards on damage and block chance and money percent.
Use world four chips to double the top left card and the bottom right card effects for more damage and item rarity chance.
Running skilling food in party dungeons does not consume it so it is like running four lattes for free.
Challenge restriction: cannot use any mana; one start with monsters helped by another player counted as an instant loss.
Neglect goldfish task; it's a waste of time.
Killing Neptunes gives the highest amount of money possible.
Temporary storage exists in this party dungeon so money stockpiles for later.
Three of a kind RNG voucher items should have been taken right away; he kept taking the wrong ones.
World 3 party dungeon has two phases: task mode building money then Boss Rush ignoring everything but bosses starting at 4:30 left.
Staying up top and just killing Neptunes was the best play for building money.
Cleared World 3 party dungeon solo carrying a full group without using horn of the full.
